landingPage.heroDescription: An open-source Astro and Tailwind CSS company site with products, services, pricing, a blog and multilingual docs, deployed on Hostinger at a reviewed version.
landingPage.about: ScrewFast is an open-source company website template built with Astro, Tailwind CSS and Preline UI by its original author. It is presented as a fictional hardware and construction brand, which makes it easy to see a full business site in action and then rebrand it for your own products or services. You get a home page with clear calls to action, services, pricing plans, a frequently asked questions section and contact details, plus a product catalogue with detail pages, a blog and an insights section. A documentation area built on Starlight adds search and several languages. Hostinger deploys the original project at a version we have checked, with its MIT license.

features.title: Company home page
features.description: A hero, trust section, service highlights and calls to action ready to rebrand.

features.title: Product catalogue
features.description: Product listings and detail pages generated from simple content files.

features.title: Pricing and FAQ
features.description: Pricing plans and an answers section to handle common questions before contact.

features.title: Blog and insights
features.description: Publish news and longer articles in Markdown with their own listing pages.

features.title: Multilingual docs
features.description: A documentation area with search and several languages, built on Starlight.

features.title: Light and dark themes
features.description: Every page supports light and dark mode out of the box.
